channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
python_min:
- '3.11'

about.description:
Magnelio is a Python library for full-wave 3D electromagnetic field
simulation.  It computes S-parameters of arbitrary 3D structures with
a conformal FIT time-domain solver on non-uniform hexahedral grids:
waveguide ports with exact discrete transparent boundaries, dispersive
and lossy materials, symmetry planes, field monitors and a cavity
eigenmode solver.  Geometry is modelled with CSG primitives and
Boolean operations on exact B-rep solids (pythonocc-core / OCCT) or
imported from STEP. Interactive browser and notebook viewer support is
included; install notebook or jupyterlab separately to run notebooks.
Results stream to an HDF5 project store with
bit-exact resume and ready-to-open ParaView sessions.  An optional
CUDA GPU backend is available via CuPy (install `cupy` separately).
about.summary: Python library for full-wave 3D electromagnetic field simulation

script: python -c "from trame_pyvista.jupyter import Widget; view = Widget(None, 'about:blank'); assert 'about:blank' in view.value; view.close()"

name: magnelio
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "0.9.3"
  # magnelio requires Python >= 3.11 (PEP 604 unions in dataclass fields,
  # tomllib).  The linter asks for this redefinition to be removed,
  # claiming the global pinning is already at or above it — it is not:
  # removing it built against 3.10.21 and pip refused the wheel
  # ("requires a different Python: 3.10.21 not in '>=3.11'"), see the
  # first CI run of PR #14.  Keep it until the global floor really moves.
  python_min: "3.11"

package:
  name: magnelio
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/m/magnelio/magnelio-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 34e296da142e95637451de57ad571a8a31af5f44da44cd970fb4a236f393359e

build:
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 0

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - hatchling
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - numpy >=1.26
    - scipy >=1.12
    - h5py >=3.10
    - matplotlib-base >=3.8
    - numba >=0.59
    - vtk >=9.3
    - pyvista >=0.44
    - pythonocc-core >=7.9
    - trame-pyvista >=0.1.5
    - ipywidgets >=8.0
    - anywidget >=0.9
    - nest-asyncio2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - magnelio
        - trame_pyvista
        - ipywidgets
        - anywidget
        - jupyterlab_widgets
        - nest_asyncio2
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - python -c "import pathlib, sys; assert (pathlib.Path(sys.prefix) / 'share/jupyter/labextensions/@jupyter-widgets/jupyterlab-manager/package.json').is_file()"
      - python -c "from trame_pyvista.jupyter import Widget; view = Widget(None, 'about:blank'); assert 'about:blank' in view.value; view.close()"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/brtkrtz/magnelio
  summary: Python library for full-wave 3D electromagnetic field simulation
  description: |
    Magnelio is a Python library for full-wave 3D electromagnetic field
    simulation.  It computes S-parameters of arbitrary 3D structures with
    a conformal FIT time-domain solver on non-uniform hexahedral grids:
    waveguide ports with exact discrete transparent boundaries, dispersive
    and lossy materials, symmetry planes, field monitors and a cavity
    eigenmode solver.  Geometry is modelled with CSG primitives and
    Boolean operations on exact B-rep solids (pythonocc-core / OCCT) or
    imported from STEP. Interactive browser and notebook viewer support is
    included; install notebook or jupyterlab separately to run notebooks.
    Results stream to an HDF5 project store with
    bit-exact resume and ready-to-open ParaView sessions.  An optional
    CUDA GPU backend is available via CuPy (install `cupy` separately).
  license: LGPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file:
    - COPYING
    - COPYING.LESSER
  documentation: https://brtkrtz.github.io/magnelio/
  repository: https://github.com/brtkrtz/magnelio

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - brtkrtz
